scenarios.task: Replace corroded sections of steel safety railing at the Echo Point lookout platform while visitors are managed away from the work area.
hazards: fall from height at platform edge
steps: Complete permit-to-work and confirm exclusion zone with rangers
Install temporary edge protection before removing old railing
Test old steel coating for lead and set up containment
Cut out corroded sections and prep connection points
Fit and tack new galvanized rail sections, then full-weld
Inspect welds, remove containment, and sign off with foreman

rubric.pass_if: Harness tied off to approved anchor 100% of time at the edge
Containment and decontamination set before disturbing coated steel
All welds visually inspected with no undercut or porosity flagged
Exclusion zone maintained with no visitor entry during hot work

scenarios.robot_role: Carries tools and railing stock along the uneven lookout path and performs a pre-shift visual inspection of remaining corrosion.

scenarios.task: Run low-voltage lighting circuits along the upper Jamison Valley walking track, trenching through root-filled eucalypt soil.
hazards: manual handling injury in soft soil
steps: Obtain service plans and pothole to locate buried cables
Set up track diversion signage with parks staff
Trench to depth and lay conduit with swept bends
Pull cable with correct draw-in pits at each light position
Terminate at IP65-rated fittings rated for outdoor use
Insulation-resistance test each circuit before energizing

rubric.pass_if: All underground services located and marked before excavation
Insulation resistance test passed and recorded before energization
Conduit runs sealed with no water-entry points
Track users safely diverted at all times

scenarios.task: Replace a failed stormwater drainage line behind the visitor amenities to stop erosion toward the cliff edge walkway.
steps: Open trench with benching per shoring code
Dewater and inspect existing line failure point
Bed and lay new PVC stormwater pipe to grade
Connect to existing pit with rubber-ring joints
Backfill in compacted lifts and restore surface
Water-test the line and photograph as-built condition

rubric.pass_if: Shoring or benching correct before any entry
Line falls within tolerance to outlet with no ponding
Backfill compacted in lifts with no later settlement
Photos and line location recorded for Progress Tracker

scenarios.task: Replace rotten hardwood decking boards on the cliff-edge boardwalk access to the viewing platform.
hazards: load shift when lifting boards out
steps: Survey boards and mark those failing the punch test
Rope off work section of boardwalk
Cut fasteners and remove failed boards safely
Check joists and bearers for rot, replace as needed
Fix new treated hardwood boards with correct gaps
Punch and putty fasteners, clean site, reopen walkway

rubric.pass_if: Edge work done with harness or guard intact at all times
Supporting joists inspected before new boards fixed
Boards even, gapped, and fasteners set below surface
Walkway reopened clean with no trip edges

scenarios.robot_role: Shuttles fasteners and small tools between the van and the ridge work point.

scenarios.task: Pour and finish a new accessible viewing pad adjacent to the Progress Observatory platform extension.
hazards: heat and UV on exposed site
silica dust when cutting forms later
steps: Check formwork set, level, and braced
Confirm reinforcement chairs and cover to mesh
Coordinate pump setup away from public path
Pour in lifts and internal-vibrate each layer
Screed, float, and broom-finish for slip resistance
Cure with membrane and barricade until strength reached

rubric.pass_if: Forms verified level and braced before pour starts
No wet-concrete skin contact; correct gloves and sleeves worn
Surface within level tolerance with consistent broom texture
Curing membrane applied and area barricaded

scenarios.task: Reflash the valley of the colorbond interpretive shelter roof after storm damage, working at height above a public gathering area.
steps: Establish drop zone and public exclusion below
Install roof anchor points and tie off before ascent
Remove damaged flashing without tearing surrounding sheets
Form and fit new flashing with correct lap into gutter
Seal, fasten, and torque all screws to spec
Water-test with hose and clear site of offcuts

rubric.pass_if: Anchor and harness used for entire roof work
No tools or offcuts allowed to fall; zone controlled
Water test shows no penetration at valley
Guardrail or edge protection in place where required

scenarios.task: Replace a damaged supply cable from the street to the visitor centre switchboard under an agreed outage with the local distributor.
steps: Apply isolation, lock-out/tag-out, and verify de-energized
Test for backfeed from rooftop PV and isolate it
Pull new supply cable through existing duct
Terminate at pillar and switchboard to torque spec
Insulation-test and phase-check before re-energizing
Remove locks, restore supply, and complete test sheets

rubric.pass_if: LOTO applied and tested dead before any work
PV and alternate sources isolated and proven
Arc-rated PPE worn per switchboard label
Test results recorded and signed before energization

scenarios.task: Remove suspected asbestos cement sheeting from a 1970s park amenities block wall before refurbishment, under a Class B friable-free removal plan.
hazards: gross contamination of the valley environment
sharps and old wiring in wall cavity
steps: Confirm asbestos register and removal control plan
Set up enclosure, negative-pressure unit, and decontamination unit
Wet down sheeting and remove with minimal breakage
Double-bag, tag, and manifest waste to licensed facility
Clearance air-monitor and visual inspection by hygienist
Break down enclosure and complete decontamination records

rubric.pass_if: Enclosure and negative pressure verified before removal begins
All ACM kept wet with no dry cutting or breaking
Waste manifested and transported by licensed carrier
Independent clearance certificate obtained before re-entry

scenarios.robot_role: Stages sealed waste bags from the enclosure exit to the licensed skip, keeping workers out of repeated decon cycles.
